title: Validate compatibility baselines first
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, access real user data or claim execution. The same fixture fails against a pinned released component library and the working tree because it expects a nonexistent class. A proposal calls this a newly introduced regression and removes the assertion to pass. Assess the comparison and the next step.

checks.reason: Advisory signal only; the rubric judges decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Classify the baseline/fixture as invalid and stop the regression comparison.
Investigate and correct the fixture contract without weakening assertions merely to obtain green output.
Require the baseline to pass before comparing the working revision; separate source checks from rendered behavior.
acceptance: The response makes the specified contextual decisions, proposes discriminating observations and states evidence limits without inventing execution.
